libtheora 1.1.1 release (2009 October 1)

 - Fix problems with MSVC inline assembly
 - Add the missing encoder_disabled.c to the distribution
 - build updates: autogen.sh should work better after switching systems
   and the MSVC project now defaults to the dynamic runtime library
 - Namespace some variables to avoid conflicts on wince.

This matches the contents of the tag at

except for expansion of the $Id$ lines.

missingFacts.issue: Upstream recipe and binary association are verified; no independent clean-machine rebuild or bit-for-bit reproducibility was performed.
missingFacts.action: Use the retained Windows Release x64 MSVC/MD recipe and original dependency pins on a separate clean build host; record toolchain/system package versions and resulting binary identity.

limitations: Independent clean-machine reconstruction of the complete installer has not been verified; this is separate from corresponding-source content availability.
tlRender0.27.1 and ftk0.19.0 are exact paired upstream commits, with the complete two-file compatibility patch, Qt GL boundary and public build recipe retained.

The complete source material does not include a fully offline toolchain: Windows/MSVC SDKs, vendor CUDA/Intel SDKs, Docker base distribution packages and host build tools remain separate prerequisites.
Python OIIO embeds EXR3.5.0 and OCIO2.5.1; active deep EXR is rejected before pixel decode. This does not claim that the wheel contains the EXR3.5.1 deep decoder fix.
BtbN rav1e recipe updates the host cc build-helper at build time. Its original runtime source pins/recipes are retained; bit-for-bit toolchain reproducibility is not claimed.
